name: Avocado Toast
steps: Mash the avocado with a pinch of salt and lemon juice.
Spread on toasted bread.
Top with sliced tomato if using.

name: Fresh Salad
steps: Chop the tomato, cucumber and onion.
Toss together with olive oil, salt and pepper.

name: Smoothie
steps: Add all fruit to a blender with a splash of milk or juice.
Blend until smooth.

name: Fruit Salad
steps: Chop the apple and orange into bite-size pieces.
Combine with the grapes.
Garnish with mint if using.

name: Guacamole
steps: Mash the avocado.
Mix in lime juice and finely chopped onion.
Fold in cilantro and tomato if using.

name: Veggie Stir-Fry
steps: Chop all vegetables into bite-size pieces.
Stir-fry in a hot pan with oil for 5–7 minutes.
Season to taste.

name: Vegetable Soup
steps: Chop all vegetables.
Simmer in stock for 20–25 minutes until tender.
Blend or serve chunky.

name: Fresh Salsa
steps: Finely dice the tomato and onion.
Mix with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

name: Green Smoothie
steps: Blend spinach and banana with a splash of water or milk.
Add kiwi or mint for extra flavor.

name: Roasted Root Vegetables
steps: Chop the vegetables into even chunks.
Toss with oil and roast at 200°C (400°F) for 30–35 minutes.

name: Mixed Berry Bowl
steps: Combine all berries in a bowl.
Garnish with mint if using.

name: Citrus Salad
steps: Peel and segment the citrus.
Arrange on a plate and garnish with mint.

name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender.
Mash with butter, milk and roasted garlic if using.

name: Pumpkin Soup
steps: Roast or simmer the pumpkin until soft.
Blend with stock, sautéed onion and garlic.

name: Tomato & Basil Salad
steps: Slice the tomatoes.
Layer with torn basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil.
